name: ToggleGroup
summary: A labelled set of toggle buttons with one tab stop, where one (type single) or several (type multiple) can be on: text style, filter chips, view options.
useWhen: Several related settings that each turn on or off and apply at once: bold, italic and underline (type multiple)
Filter chips over a list, where any number can be on (type multiple)
A compact choice in a toolbar where turning the only on item off is allowed, so none may be on (type single)
A set of toggles that should be one tab stop and move with the arrow keys
avoidWhen: Exactly one option must always be on (a view or a mode)
A choice in a form that is saved with the form
Actions that run once rather than stay on
A single setting on its own

insteadUse.One setting on its own: ToggleButton, or Switch in a settings list

type.description: single: at most one item on, Radix renders role radiogroup with radio items. multiple: any number on, role toolbar with pressed buttons.

value.description: Controlled. A string for single (empty string for none), a list for multiple. Pair with onValueChange.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value. For single, an empty string when the on item is turned off.

aria-label.description: The group's name, for example Text style. Required unless aria-labelledby is set.

aria-labelledby.description: The id of a visible heading that names the group. Required unless aria-label is set.

size.description: Passed to every item that does not set its own size. Spaced xs and sm groups use the smaller gap.

emphasis.description: Passed to every item that does not set its own. No default: items are soft, as ToggleButton.

shape.description: Passed to every item that does not set its own. No default. Attached, only the outer corners take the shape.

orientation.description: A row with ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, or a column with ArrowUp and ArrowDown. Sets data-orientation.

attached.description: Joins the items into one seamed control: no gap, inner corners square on the logical sides (they flip in RTL), a 1px divider. Sets data-attached.

disabled.description: Every item is disabled: aria-disabled, does not toggle, stays focusable. Sets data-disabled on the root.

loop.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first and back.

children.description: ToggleGroupItems, each with a unique value. The item takes children (the label), start, end, icon with label for the icon only form, and disabled, as ToggleButton.

a11y.role: radiogroup of radio items with aria-checked (type single), or toolbar of buttons with aria-pressed (type multiple); named by aria-label or aria-labelledby
a11y.focus: One tab stop: Tab enters on the on item (or the first), the arrows move between items. Focus alone does not toggle. Disabled items keep aria-disabled and stay focusable and in the arrow order (anatomy rule 5), so a Tooltip can say why; they do not toggle.

keys.Tab: Moves focus into the group, on the on item or the first item, then out of it
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus out of the group, backward
keys.ArrowRight: Moves focus to the next item in the reading direction (the previous one in RTL); wraps
keys.ArrowLeft: Moves focus to the previous item in the reading direction (the next one in RTL); wraps
keys.ArrowDown: In a vertical group, moves focus to the next item; wraps
keys.ArrowUp: In a vertical group, moves focus to the previous item; wraps
keys.Home: Moves focus to the first item
keys.End: Moves focus to the last item

a11y.announce: The group name when focus enters, then each item by its name with checked or not checked (single) or pressed or not pressed (multiple), and its position in the set.
notes: On is not told by color alone: an on item gets the ToggleButton inner ring, and Highlight in forced colors.
Every icon only item needs its own label: the group name does not name its items.
Keep each label the same in both states; the checked or pressed state carries it.
Under forced colors the focus outline of an attached item is pulled inside it, so the next item does not cover it.
The native role above is for type single. Type multiple is a toolbar of buttons with the selected (pressed) state.
While an on item of an attached group has keyboard focus, its inner ring gives way to the focus ring; the on fill still tells the state.

en.name: Name the group by what its items set: Text style, Task filters, Board view. Sentence case.
en.labels: Each item is a short noun in sentence case: Bold, Open, Grid. The same words in both states.

ar.name: Noun form, no diacritics: فلاتر المهام، عرض اللوحة.
ar.labels: Short noun form labels, no diacritics: مفتوحة، قائمة، شبكة. Never the imperative.

react.behavior: radix:ToggleGroup; items are ToggleButton roots on ButtonBase
react.note: The axes reach the items through ButtonGroupContext, which ButtonRoot reads; an item's own prop wins. No motion of its own: items keep Button's.

angular.behavior: div[dsToggleGroup] and button[dsToggleGroupItem] on DsButtonBase, hand built with the Radix ToggleGroup DOM on behavior/roving-radio.ts (CDK FocusKeyManager and Directionality), ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: The group host is the root (role radiogroup for single, toolbar for multiple); each item host is a ToggleButton root with data-part item. Inputs take the React prop names; onValueChange is the valueChange output of [(value)], a string for single and a list for multiple. start, end and icon take an icon name or a TemplateRef. The axes reach the items through DS_BUTTON_GROUP; an item input wins. Disabled items stay in the arrow order and focusable. A press is decided synchronously in a click listener added after the first render, so a caller (click) that calls preventDefault() keeps the state. With a one way [value], the local state still moves on a press, as an Angular model does. Works with reactive and template forms. ToggleGroup.css and Button.css are used as is.

native.note: 44pt on iOS, 48dp on Android. Attached corners through the style function, flipped by I18nManager.

styles.studio: Overlay filled items; an on item steps up the fill and gets the 2px inner ring. Attached, the seam is color.border.default and only the outer corners take radius.control.
styles.desk: Pill items; attached, the group reads as one pill with square inner corners.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A ToggleGroup type single used for views, where turning the on item off leaves no view
mistakes.right: SegmentedControl, which always keeps one option on

mistakes.wrong: Each item a separate tab stop, built from loose ToggleButtons
mistakes.right: ToggleGroup, one tab stop with arrow keys

mistakes.wrong: A group with no aria-label or aria-labelledby
mistakes.right: A name that says what the items set: Text style

mistakes.wrong: Icon only items with no label
mistakes.right: label on every icon only item: List view, Grid view

mistakes.wrong: A ToggleGroup of form options saved with a submit button
mistakes.right: RadioGroup or a Checkbox group inside a Field
